create_CO3DDataset: create a CO3DDataset instance with CO3DConfig specifying dataset root, categories, and batch settings
build_recentered_poses: build recentered camera poses and pointclouds for all sequences in a CO3DDataset
sample_spherical_poses: sample uniform camera poses on a sphere with configurable radius, phi range, and theta elevation
convert_camera_conventions: convert pytorch3d PerspectiveCameras to OpenCV world2cam pose and intrinsic matrix with crop and resize adjustments
get_multi_view_batch: get a batch of parallel frames from a CO3D sequence using random, sequence, or fixed-frames selection mode
